root_cause.text: The `__cdns3_gadget_ep_queue` function in the cdns3 USB gadget driver fails to verify if the endpoint descriptor (`ep->desc`) is NULL before processing a queue request on an unconfigured or disabled endpoint.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (!ep->desc) return -ESHUTDOWN;` at the beginning of `__cdns3_gadget_ep_queue` in `drivers/usb/cdns3/cdns3-gadget.c` to prevent a NULL pointer dereference when the endpoint is not ready.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null check for the endpoint descriptor in __cdns3_gadget_ep_queue to prevent dereferencing a null pointer during shutdown.
intent_record.what: Added a null check for ep->desc at the beginning of the __cdns3_gadget_ep_queue function, returning -ESHUTDOWN if it is null.
intent_record.how: This prevents potential null pointer dereferences when attempting to queue a request on an endpoint that has been disabled or shut down.
